Chock CLI: one entry point, one subcommand per activity.

Usage: chock <command> [args]

Everyday:
  init       Scaffold a consumer repo (wiring only -- no policies)
  add        Install a policy or skill from a catalog and compile it
  install    Build a chock.sh selection into one plugin for one agent (install --selection <file> [--client C])
  remove     Remove an installed policy and resync
  sync       Recompile + rewire so the repo matches its policies (--ci/--skills for extras)
  check      Run every truth check: validate, verify, evals, matrix (--only to narrow; --history scans past commits; --floor, a preview, judges a pull request's merge result with its base's gates; it holds only as a required check the pull request cannot redefine, and judges committed content only)
  status     Policy states and coverage (--only registry,log for more)
  stop       Refuse every agent tool call, commit and push here until resume (--agent C for one client)
  resume     Lift a stop: agents are judged by the policies again
  doctor     Check each client's hooks on each route: present, current, and seen running (--client X); --live runs each hook on a canary
  incident   An ordered, redacted timeline from the local decision log (incident --since T [--until T] [--share])
  witness    Export one client's redacted decision log for its agentseam evidence issue (witness export --client C)
  enable     Enable a policy by id
  disable    Disable a policy by id
  bundle     Switch a member of an installed plugin bundle on or off (bundle on|off <id>, bundle status)

Authoring:
  new        Create a deterministic artifact skeleton
  compile    Low-level single-policy compile
  emit       Write a vendor's managed-settings bundle under --out for an admin to deploy (emit --managed claude_code --python <abs> --on-failure block|allow --out <dir>); refuses an --out that is a filesystem root or inside a system folder
  install-skills Install bundled authoring skills into agent skill dirs (write mode; check via CI)
  registry   Scan/list/resolve the artifact registry
  plugin     Package policies as installable plugins (plugin build [--format claude] [--check])
  marketplace Emit marketplace index files over a built plugin tree (marketplace build --dist <dir>)
  gateway    Run the MCP gateway proxy (gateway run --repo . -- <server command>)
  mcp        Serve the read-only chock_guidance MCP tool over stdio (mcp --repo .)
  review     Produce or check reviewer evidence (review emit | review verify <file> | review require)
  compliance Generate a compliance coverage report (compliance report --framework owasp_asi)
